inputs.text: [excited] She was 4 meters long — like a small car! [amazed] She was as tall as a 4-year-old! And she weighed 2,200 kilos — [serious] as heavy as a rhino!
[gasps] A turtle as heavy as a rhino?
[chuckles] A turtle as heavy as a rhino, yes — [confident] but one that floated, thanks to her big flippers.
